rows.note: unnamed wrappers that take `Stats` and `BaseData` from `LCharWarlockElemental` or an Elemental voice list. The list rolls one school at random, Fire, Ice or Storm, then that school's ladder 1–46 (the rungs on *Pyromancers*, *Cryomancers* and *Electromancers*); the voice copy draws 1–36. Placed: `LvlWarlockElemental` 01E7CB ×14 · `LvlWarlockElementalAggro1024` 0CDE3B ×5 · `LvlWarlockElementalAmbush` 0CA44E ×2 (through `LvlWarlockElemental`) · `LvlWarlockElementalAmbushCondescendingF` 0CA449 (not placed; through `LvlWarlockElementalAmbush`) · `DunPOITundraMarshWarlock` 0DCFF4 ×1 (through `…Aggro1024`; Tundra Marsh) · `dunFellglowJailor` 0CABB4 ×1 (through `LvlWarlockElementalAmbush`) · `dunFellglow_LvlWarlockElementalAmbushHoldPosition` 0CA447 ×1 (through `LvlWarlockElemental`) · `dunFellglow_LvlWarlockElementalAmbushCondescendingFHoldPosition` 0CA44F ×1 (through `…AmbushCondescendingF`) · `LvlWarlockElementalElfHaughtyM` 081F0D ×1 (voice list `LCharWarlockElementalElfHaughtyM`) (26 in all). `LvlWarlockElementalElfHaughtyM` (`FellglowKeep01`) moved here from Uncategorised → *Unfiled Leveled Wrappers* (user, 2026-10-03).

items: Changing the Fire, Ice or Storm rungs (on *Pyromancers*, *Cryomancers*, *Electromancers*), which `LCharWarlockElemental` draws, also needs six records that take their template from `LvlWarlockElemental` 01E7CB without `Stats`: the Ghosts of the Tribunal temple staff `ccASVSSE001_CaretakerIneril` 001017, `…Priest02` 000E77, `…Priest03` 001025, `…PriestDrureth` 000F12 (1) and `…ElderDrevlan` 000840 (PC×1 [4–100]), all ccasvsse001-almsivi.esm, on Factions → Minor Factions → *Ghosts of the Tribunal*; and `ccBGSSSE013_GreenGuardian` 000845:ccbgssse013-dawnfang.esl (PC×1 [10–70], on Undead → Ghosts → *Ghost Bosses*). They keep their own levels and take only spells (or look and AI) from the wrapper.
The rung templates themselves and their own-level records are on *Pyromancers*, *Cryomancers* and *Electromancers*.
Every other record here (every Elemental wrapper) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
